title: Property tax second installment due
body: Notice from the Town of Fernhollow (invented). The second installment of 2026 property tax, $1,284.50 per average household, is due by November 15, 2026. Payments received after November 15, 2026 incur a 1.5% monthly penalty. Pay at Town Hall, 12 Elm Road, Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m., or online. Homeowners only; renters do not pay this tax.

title: Road resurfacing on Larch Street
body: Larch Street between 3rd and 7th Avenue will be resurfaced from October 26, 2026 to October 30, 2026. Expect delays between 7 a.m. and 5 p.m. No action is needed from residents; vehicles parked on the street between 7 a.m. and 5 p.m. may be towed.

title: Senior heating assistance applications
body: Residents aged 65 or older with household income under $42,000 may apply for the winter heating credit of $350. Applications must be received by December 1, 2026 at the Senior Center, 4 Willow Lane. Late applications are not accepted.

title: Town council meeting schedule
body: The Fernhollow Town Council meets on the first Tuesday of each month at 7 p.m. in the Council Chamber, 12 Elm Road. Agendas are posted 3 days before each meeting. Attendance is optional.
